brief: 5 secret IDE skills that turn average devs into senior shipping machines.

slots.cardText: A brutalist breakdown of the hidden features that separate juniors from senior shipping machines.

slots.toolTagline: Jump to any symbol in seconds without touching your mouse.
slots.bodyText: Master Go to Symbol and Peek Definition to read code like a senior. Stop scrolling, start teleporting.
slots.feat1Sub: Hit Ctrl+Shift+O to browse functions inside any file.
slots.feat2Sub: Inline popups let you trace logic without losing context.
slots.feat3Sub: F2 refactor propagates changes across the entire codebase.

slots.toolTagline: Kill bugs in half the time with conditional breakpoints.
slots.bodyText: Set conditional breakpoints and logpoints to inspect state without cluttering your code with print statements.
slots.feat1Sub: Break only when variables meet your exact criteria.
slots.feat2Sub: Trace values inline without stopping execution flow.
slots.feat3Sub: Monitor live state changes across nested call stacks.

slots.toolTagline: Read blame inline and never fear legacy code again.
slots.bodyText: Use inline blame and heatmaps to understand who wrote what and why. Context is everything when shipping fast.
slots.feat1Sub: See commit authors and dates directly in the gutter.
slots.feat2Sub: Visualize which files change most often at a glance.
slots.feat3Sub: Jump through every revision of a single line instantly.

slots.toolTagline: Edit fifty lines at once with surgical precision.
slots.bodyText: Combine Cmd+D selection with regex find-and-replace to refactor entire APIs in under thirty seconds.
slots.feat1Sub: Chain identical selections with a single keyboard shortcut.
slots.feat2Sub: Draw vertical cursors to edit aligned data or JSON blocks.
slots.feat3Sub: Capture groups transform messy imports into clean modules.

slots.toolTagline: Let AI handle boilerplate while you architect logic.
slots.bodyText: Use composer or inline chat to generate tests, refactor legacy files, and scaffold features without leaving your flow.
slots.feat1Sub: Highlight a block and ask the AI to rewrite or explain it.
slots.feat2Sub: Multi-file edits with automatic diff review and apply.
slots.feat3Sub: The agent reads your imports and types before writing code.

slots.toolTagline: Run builds, tests, and git commands without leaving your editor.
slots.bodyText: Bind npm scripts and custom tasks to key chords so you build, test, and deploy from the same pane you code in.
slots.feat1Sub: Split panes to keep logs visible next to your source code.
slots.feat2Sub: Map test suites to single shortcuts for instant feedback loops.
slots.feat3Sub: Click any error in terminal output to jump straight to the line.

slots.ctaBody: Pick one skill, practice it for thirty minutes, and watch your velocity double this week.
